input: Set up a weekly pantry audit to reduce waste

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Weekly Pantry Audit System
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to establish a recurring weekly pantry audit routine to track food inventory and reduce household waste.

questions.title: Which day and time works best for your audit?
questions.description: Identify the specific day of the week and time of day the user prefers to conduct the pantry audit.

questions.title: How many people does your pantry need to serve?
questions.description: Understand the household size to tailor the scope and categories of the audit appropriately.

questions.title: What types of food does your pantry currently store?
questions.description: Determine whether the pantry includes dry goods, canned items, spices, snacks, or other categories to structure the audit checklist.

questions.title: What is your biggest waste problem right now?
questions.description: Find out whether the main issue is expiry dates being missed, overbuying, forgotten items, or disorganisation.

questions.title: Do you want a digital or paper-based tracking method?
questions.description: Clarify the user's preferred format for logging audit results, such as a spreadsheet, app, or handwritten checklist.

questions.title: Should the audit connect to your grocery shopping list?
questions.description: Determine whether the audit output should directly feed into what the user buys each week to avoid duplicates and gaps.

questions.title: How much time are you willing to spend each week?
questions.description: Establish a realistic time budget per session so the audit process can be designed to fit within that constraint.
